text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. As I was walking past the front 
of the station, I spotted two familiar 
faces calling out to passersby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
P-Ple... ase...! Coming up, um... at 
Tracen Academy... we're...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We are holding an event hosted by the 
Student Council! We are handing out 
flyers, so please take a look!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Senpai... I'm sorry for doing such a poor 
job. At this rate, I'm barely being any 
help at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. Pay it no mind. I'm certain you 
will gradually grow accustomed to—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me. It seems I've received an 
email from the President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
'Please return to the academy 
immediately'... I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to hand out at least half of 
them, but there is no choice. Let's head 
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Senpai, please go ahead. I'll hand them 
out by myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However... will you be alright? Standing 
before the gazes of passersby, and 
speaking with demographic groups you 
struggle with—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know. ...But, I want to be of help to 
you too, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. However, do not push 
yourself beyond your limits, understood?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Inhale... exhale...... I'm fine. I can do 
this. All I have to say is 'We're holding 
an event' after all...

text_block_list.name: Passing Man
text_block_list.text:
An event? Being held at Tracen Academy? 
Maybe I'll take a flyer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: !? ...H-Help... yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
T-That was just a warm-up... Next time for 
sure, I'll project my voice properly and 
hand the flyer directly over...!

text_block_list.name: Group of Tourists
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! Is that girl over there from Tracen 
Academy? Ah, she looked over here! Look, 
it's that girl right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if they're looking... I won't... 
mind it. ...I won't... let it get to 
me............gh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's no use... I can't do it at all. What 
should I do... when Senpai entrusted this 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even though I resolved back then to 
overcome this wall—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No matter what wall stands in the way, I 
have to overcome it— 'Advancing toward the 
ideal version of myself' means doing 
exactly that, right, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And yet... I... in the end, I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober was trembling in anguish. 
Isn't there something I can say to blow 
away her anxiety...?!
choice_data_list: I'll help you hand them out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober was trembling in anguish. 
Isn't there something I can say to blow 
away her anxiety...?!
choice_data_list: I'll help you hand them out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: !? Y-Yes... Wait, you're—

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—Flyers? Are you guys holding some kind of 
event? —Whoa! It's at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, it comes with an autograph lottery 
ticket for the event! —Really?! Flyer, 
please! —Me too, me too! Give me one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh!? Wah, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I had shouted too loudly, 
a crowd so large that one person couldn't 
possibly handle them all began surging 
toward us...!
choice_data_list: L-Let's split up and hand them out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No way... We finished handing out all of 
them? Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh... I-I wasn't talking to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... thanks. There's no way I could've 
handed them all out alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All of them? Don't tell me you 
distributed every single flyer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Impressive... That far exceeded my 
expectations. It seems my worry was 
entirely unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dober... you have truly changed. Seeing 
your growth brings me great joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But... this wasn't by my own power. I had 
help. So...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Leave it at that for now. The day 
will come when you understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, the results speak for themselves, 
and you did save me. Allow me to say this 
much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, you as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... from me, too. ...Well... you did 
help out quite a bit. Bye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um! From me too... Thank you very much, 
honestly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Catching a fleeting glimpse of Mejiro 
Dober's profile, perhaps out of 
fulfillment from handing out the flyers... 
a subtle smile lingered on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah?! Th-The wind is so strong—wait, 
the flyers are blowing away...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Caught in a sudden gust of strong wind, 
every single flyer went scattering 
everywhere! I scrambled in a rush to help 
gather them up—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Somehow, we... 
retrieved all of them, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I've just retur—... Hey, what 
happened?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. What a disaster that was. 
............Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes. Senpai, I'm... really sorr—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You did well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In the past, you wouldn't have even been 
able to step forward, right? I am glad to 
see your growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No way, what growth...? You entrusted this 
to me, yet I couldn't hand out a single 
flyer...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Leave it at that for now. The day 
will come when you understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Trainer over there, good work to you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober headed back toward the 
academy, looking deep in thought as she 
pondered the meaning behind Air Groove's 
words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh... wait, that badge on your collar—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Tch... Leave me alone. Don't go acting 
like you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, thank you. But I can't cause 
trouble for you, so I'll just take the 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Urgh! You're persistent. I can do this 
alone. I have to be able to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, really, I'm completely fine. Rather, I 
need to do this by myself...!

text_block_list.name: Passing Students
text_block_list.text:
—What's going on? Some kind of commotion? 
—Looks like they're handing out flyers, 
wonder what it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh? ...Ah, um...!
choice_data_list: Yes! We're hosting an upcoming event!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Ah, geez!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... you're too soft-hearted. I'm 
seriously going to take you up on that, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, forcing my help onto her a little, 
I assisted in passing out the flyers—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We finally handed out half of 
them, but it's already evening. ...If I 
hold out for just a bit longer—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, good work. That is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Impressive, to think you actually managed 
to hand out half. You did exceptionally 
well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Dober, you've grown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not true. All I did was cause 
a scene.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In the end, calling people over and 
handing out the flyers, I only pulled it 
off because I had help. So...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Leave it at that for now. The day 
will come when you understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, the results speak for themselves, 
and you did save me. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... I thought you were meddling, 
but... You helped... so for what it's 
worth. ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
From me too! Sorry for giving you trouble. 
And... really, thank you very much!
